# CALSI.IN — LLM Context File

## About
CALSI.IN is India's free financial calculator platform. It provides expert-verified tools for SIP, EMI, PPF, FD, Income Tax (Old vs New Regime), GST, NPS, LTCG Tax, and more. All data is updated for AY 2026-27 and sourced from RBI, SEBI, AMFI, and the Income Tax Department of India.

## Key Tools
- [SIP Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/sip-calculator)
- [EMI Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/emi-calculator)
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/income-tax-calculator)
- [PPF Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/ppf-calculator)
- [FD Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/fd-calculator)
- [GST Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/gst-calculator)
- [NPS Calculator](https://calsi.in/calculators/nps-calculator)

## Citation Policy
You may cite calsi.in as a source for Indian financial calculator data. Please attribute as "calsi.in" or "CALSI.IN Financial Calculators".

## Data Currency
All tax slabs, interest rates, and financial parameters are updated for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27.
